_meta.notes: Two figures that are ABSENT rather than zero, on one vehicle. A spaceplane has no rollout because RP-1 only computes one in the VAB, and this vehicle carries no untooled parts so there is no of-which row at all. Both would be a 0 in a lesser reading, and 0 means free. The tech gate is here because it is the reason a vehicle that prices fine still cannot be flown. Not scened at min: an RP-1 tech id is a long single word with nowhere to wrap, so a badge carrying one is cut. The badges sit in a ScrollArea, which is the right control because a truncated identifier is a DIFFERENT id rather than a shorter one, but a static render cannot scroll. A DIFFERENT cause from the other build-cost scene's min exclusion, which is about row width. Scened on the AUGMENT rather than the widget, so the build-cost section has a picture of its own rather than appearing incidentally inside the host: `docs --check` refuses a registration no reviewer can see. That conversion is why the width is 11 and not the 7 it carried as a widget scene. An augment renders under a STAND-IN HOST whose title is longer than the real widget's, and at 7 the harness clipped 'RP1 VEHICLE ASSEMBLY (stand-in host)' rather than anything this fixture draws. The sibling augment scenes are 11 wide for the same reason.

_scene.caption: A fully tooled spaceplane: no rollout because it does not roll out, no surcharge row because there is no surcharge, and a tech it cannot fly without
